bullets: Leading: Hire, coach, and develop PMs. Give direct feedback, know each PM's growth areas, and step in early when a PM or project starts to slip.
Setting direction: Set the vision for onchain compliance and prioritize across your PMs. Define success and failure with real metrics.
Staying hands-on: Own a few critical initiatives yourself. Prototype, build AI agents, and ship alongside your team.
Closing: Build ongoing customer relationships and join strategic deals. Turn what you hear into roadmap unlocks.
Reporting and risk: Tell leadership how Onchain Compliance is doing, using real metrics. Call out risks early and unblock PMs before projects fail.
Pathfinding: Get in front of customers before there's anything to show. Surface problems they can't fully articulate, and turn a morning conversation into a same-day spec.
Shaping: Turn customer insight into a solution. Prototype with designers, with customers in the loop.
Building: Ship in hours and days. Build AI agents into the product and your workflow, and ship code alongside engineers and the Product Cortex.
Closing: Be present in the deal. Lead demos, run scoping calls, and turn field feedback into roadmap unlocks.
